# Where novelty's gain comes from / 新的增益从哪里来

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`where-novelty-gain-comes-from` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](where-novelty-gain-comes-from.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> With the rest counted, every rise is given; under the first law a family without repetition gains from the rest or across its boundary; a finite whole the rest gives nothing net returns and is not new at every step; novelty and endless new formation need gain.
>
> 算入其余，每次上升都是被给予的；在第一律之下，不重复的家族的增益来自其余或跨过边界；其余不给净量的有限整体回返，不是每步都新；新与不止的新形成需要增益。

## Laws / 规律

1. With the rest of the whole counted (Flow.withImbalance), across a step at which a family's stock rises some relatum taking part gives the family more than it takes from it, a formation taking part or the rest; it is found by checking each one taking part, deciding nothing infinite; a rise over a stretch is given at some step of it.<br>算入整体的其余（Flow.withImbalance），跨一步家族的存量上升时，某个参与的关系项给家族的多于从它取的，是参与的形成或其余；它由逐个核对参与者找到，不判定任何无穷的事；一段上的上升在其中某步被给予。 (`Becoming.Flow.NetGiver`, `Becoming.Flow.rise_netGiver`, `Becoming.Flow.netGiver_cases`, `Becoming.Flow.rise_given`, `Becoming.Flow.rise_given_between`, `Becoming.some_mem_tail`)
2. The rest gives the family net exactly where, summed over the family, the levels rose beyond what the formations gave net by more than they fell beyond what the formations took net; where the flow balances on the family, the rest gives it nothing net.<br>其余给家族净量，恰当在家族上相加，水平的上升超出各形成净给予的多于水平的下降超出它们净取用的；流在家族上平衡时，其余不给净量。 (`Becoming.Flow.rest_netGiver_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.rest_not_netGiver`)
3. Under the first law (Flow.Gainless), a family without repetition that rises across a step is given net by the rest or is open there: some formation taking part exchanges beyond it.<br>在第一律之下（Flow.Gainless），不重复的家族跨一步上升时，其余给它净量，或它在那里开放（某个参与的形成与家族之外交换）。 (`Becoming.Flow.rise_from_rest_or_open`)
4. Where a list holds every condition without repetition, the whole has no boundary to cross, and under the first law every rise of it is the rest's; with the rest giving it nothing net from T on, it stays within its stock at T, has two equal configurations from every step on, does not carry the count of endless exchanges, and is not new at every step.<br>一个列表不重复地持有每个条件时，整体没有边界可越，在第一律之下每次上升都是其余的；从 T 起其余不给净量时，整体留在 T 处的存量之内，从每一步起有两步构型相同，交换不止时不承载交换的计数，所以不是每步都新。 (`Becoming.Flow.whole_rise_from_rest`, `Becoming.Flow.whole_bounded_of_rest_idle`, `Becoming.Flow.whole_recurs_of_rest_idle`, `Becoming.Flow.whole_not_new_of_rest_idle`)
5. Novelty needs gain: a family whose configurations at the steps T, …, T + N all differ, N the number of configurations within its stock at T, rises at one of those steps; one new at every step rises at arbitrarily late steps; so do first visits without end (configurations not had since T), consecutive or not.<br>新需要增益：T 到 T + N 各步构型两两不同、N 为 T 处存量内构型之数时，家族在其中某步上升；每步都新的家族在任意晚处上升；首次到访（构型自 T 起未曾有过）不止亦然，不必连续。 (`Becoming.le_of_increasing`, `Becoming.Web.rises_within_of_new`, `Becoming.Web.rises_late_of_new`, `Becoming.Web.NewAt`, `Becoming.Web.exceeds_of_firsts`, `Becoming.Web.rises_late_of_firsts`)
6. A family holding the members of one new at every step is new at every step too; under the first law each such rise comes from the rest or across the family's boundary, for every family without repetition holding it: no finite family closes over endless novelty.<br>含一个每步都新的家族之成员的家族也每步都新；在第一律之下，每次这样的上升来自其余或跨过家族的边界，对含它的每个不重复的家族都如此：没有有限的家族封闭于无尽的新。 (`Becoming.map_eq_at`, `Becoming.map_eq_on`, `Becoming.Web.config_eq_of_sub`, `Becoming.Web.new_of_sub`, `Becoming.Flow.new_from_rest_or_open`, `Becoming.Flow.new_beyond_every`)
7. New formation needs gain: where what a formation requires, and how much, stays fixed and lies within the family (Web.RequiresWithin), whether the family's levels support it depends on the configuration alone, so a step at which it is first supported is a first visit; with formations first supported without end, the family rises at arbitrarily late steps, under the first law from the rest or across the boundary.<br>新形成需要增益：一个形成所要求者及其多少固定、只在家族之内时（Web.RequiresWithin），家族的水平是否支持它只取决于构型，所以它首次被支持之步是一次首次到访；首次被支持的形成不止时，家族在任意晚处上升，在第一律之下来自其余或跨过边界。 (`Becoming.Web.RequiresWithin`, `Becoming.Web.supported_of_config`, `Becoming.Web.FirstSupported`, `Becoming.Web.newAt_of_first`, `Becoming.Web.rises_late_of_newly_supported`, `Becoming.Flow.newly_supported_from_rest_or_open`)
8. Witness: in Web.counting, whose level is the step, nothing takes part (Flow.empty, under which nothing comes from nothing); it is new at every step, and the rest gives it one unit at every step, the one way in that a finite whole has.<br>见证：Web.counting 的水平就是步数，没有形成参与（Flow.empty，无中生有不成立）；它每步都新，其余每步给它一单位，这是有限的整体唯一的增益之路。 (`Becoming.add_one_sub_self`, `Becoming.Flow.empty`, `Becoming.Flow.empty_gainless`, `Becoming.Flow.counting_given_by_rest`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom. What each law needs is written into it: the first law (Flow.Gainless), the family listed without repetition (Distinct), for the whole a list holding every condition, the rest giving nothing net from T on, what a formation requires fixed within the family (Web.RequiresWithin); the giver is found by checking each relatum taking part, deciding only inequalities of natural numbers.<br>不加公理。各律所写者写在定理中：第一律（Flow.Gainless），家族列举不重复（Distinct），对整体有一个列表持有每个条件，从 T 起其余不给净量，形成所要求者固定于家族之内（Web.RequiresWithin）；给予者由逐个核对参与者找到，只判定自然数的不等式。

## Does not show / 未表明

- Whether an actual part is open, which relatum the rest is in an actual unfolding, or whether its exchange is without end: these are correspondence, given per application.<br>实际的部分是否开放，其余在实际展开中是哪个关系项，其交换是否不止：这些是对应，按应用给出。
- Gain is not openness: a family can be closed and gain from the rest, and openness can carry a net of zero.<br>增益不是开放：家族可以封闭而从其余得到增益，开放也可以净量为零。 Witness: `Becoming.Flow.counting_given_by_rest`.
- Whether the bound by the configurations within the stock is reached, by a family realizing that many first visits, is not stated.<br>界内构型数之界是否可达（是否有家族实现这么多次首次到访）没有陈述。
- No correspondence to open systems or free energy in thermodynamics is checked.<br>与热力学的开放系统或自由能的对应不由此检查。
- Continuous time and real amounts are not stated.<br>连续时间与实数的量没有陈述。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Web.counting with Flow.empty: nothing takes part and the family is closed, yet counting on is new at every step, the rest giving one unit at every step; so the condition that the rest gives nothing net cannot be dropped from the return of a finite whole.<br>Web.counting 与 Flow.empty：没有形成参与、家族封闭，计数仍每步都新，其余每步给一单位；所以有限整体回返的定理中“其余不给净量”不能去掉。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Gain.lean)

Ren, 15 October 2026: “What's the best choices to make? please make best of your judgement, and push the frontier of completeness”. The readings of returning-novelty-forgetting-on-levels, that novelty without end is gain without bound which must come from beyond the part, and that a bounded present cannot hold its own history, become theorems here: with the rest counted every rise is given; under the first law gain has two ways in, across the boundary or from the rest; a finite whole has no boundary, and with the rest idle it returns and forgets. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D5, D7): “gain from beyond the part” reads as these two ways in; openness and gain are kept apart; 生生不息 reads at the level of the whole, where in a bounded whole with the rest idle it is return, not endless novelty; the rest counts what the listed relata do not, so a finite whole new without end is one whose listing leaves out what gives to it. Becoming.Coupling states the counterpart for moves: moves formed by what a list holds repeat within the list's length.<br>Ren 2026-10-15：“What's the best choices to make? please make best of your judgement, and push the frontier of completeness”。returning-novelty-forgetting-on-levels 的读法“新而不止是无界的增益，必须来自部分之外”与“有界的当下不能承载自身的历史”在此成为定理：算入其余，每次上升都是被给予的；在第一律之下增益只有两条路，跨过边界或来自其余；有限的整体没有边界，其余闲置时它回返而遗忘。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 2026-10-15 的交托采用，DELEGATED-CHOICES D5、D7）：“来自部分之外的增益”读作这两条路；开放与增益分开；生生不息读在整体的层次，在其余闲置的有界整体中它是回返，不是无尽的新；其余计入所列关系项不做的，所以无尽地新的有限整体，是其列表漏掉了给予它者。Becoming.Coupling 对动作陈述其对应：列表所持者形成的动作在列表长度之内重复。
